description.text: UCL’s truly exceptional research deserves a chance to change the world, with the expert support to make it happen.

targetApplicants.text: Whether you’re at the earliest stage of an idea and want to understand its commercial viability, or preparing to launch a spinout, a serial academic entrepreneur or simply dipping your toe into the commercial world, we guide you carefully and collaboratively.
